correctness.rationale: Every centered genuine symmetric hexagon is a three-segment zonotope. An affine normalization gives generators (1,0), (0,1), (p,q) with p,q>0. Dual vertices are determined by consecutive support lines; standard exact polygon second-moment formulas independently generate the displayed symmetric rational expression for the polar product. A symmetric degree-nine upper-deficit polynomial has 46 positive coefficients after ordering determinant magnitudes; a strictly positive W^7*(U^2+UV+V^2) term forces equality only for equal determinant magnitudes, i.e. affine-regular hexagons. The lower deficit factors as a positive prefactor times an explicit 19-positive-term polynomial. The actual embedded verifier reproduces all expressions in exact arithmetic, including boundaries and 20 rational sanity cases; universal validity rests on the polynomial identity and geometric parametrization.
